Then nothing is released

  Scenario: AC6 A consumed call fails or does not answer
    Given the rwb-case contract mock does not answer the case read or the case-move answer for case "RC-2026-000719"
    When the step runs
    Then nothing is written and no case move is answered
    Then the caller sees 503 with the platform error envelope

  Scenario: AC7 A status change the model does not allow is refused
    Given the legal action "LA-2026-000719" is at the status "CLOSED" or "WITHDRAWN", or at a stage other than "LED_AUCTION" or "WRIT_AND_SEIZURE"
    When a round result is recorded
    Then the system answers 409 and no rule fires
    Then nothing changes

  Scenario: AC8 Role without the Litigation right is refused on every operation
    Given a role without the Litigation right of the operation
    When the action is opened, a round is recorded or the action is read
    Then the system answers 403 before any read or write
    Then nothing changes and no decision record is written

  Scenario: AC9 Boundary of the tables and the statements
    Given a component, a statement or a test reaches a "recovery_case" row, an "assignment" row, a "task" row, a "rule_row", a "decision_log_entry", a proceeds row or another service's schema
    When the boundary test runs
    Then the grant refuses the statement and the build fails
    Then nothing is released

  Scenario: AC10 Business rules BR1 to BR9 hold
    Given the step runs on the rule package in force
    When the boundary test and the decision record are checked
    Then the decision record is written before any change, with the rule ID and the package version
    Then no recovery_case, assignment or task row is written, and only status and the standard record columns are written on the action
    Then the rules BR1 to BR9 hold as stated in section 8

  Scenario: AC11 Error answers of the provided operations
    Given a call to the provided operations arrives
    When the caller is not authenticated, the role does not hold the Litigation right, or the legal action does not exist or is outside the caller's scope
    Then the system answers 401, 403 or 404 respectively
    Then nothing is written
